result.brief: 提出1Step-WAM，将世界动作模型的多步动作去噪压缩为单步前向，并用轻量校准器与带宽约束解码降低误差，使动作生成与视觉预填充并行，实现大幅推理加速。
result.reason: World action model unifying visual world modeling and action generation; one-step action denoising with parallel visual prefilling. Main contribution is efficiency for embodied WAM, so secondary application direction.
